definitions: A main division of a book, typically with a number or title.
A local branch of a society, fraternity, or religious order.
A period or event in history or in a person's life.
The body of canons of a cathedral or collegiate church, or of the members of a religious house.
examples: The new chapter meets on Tuesdays.
That was an important chapter in her life.
The chapter elected a new dean.
